data.name: Twilight Protocol
data.detailed_description:
🌒 About This Game

Twilight Protocol is an atmospheric detective horror about a man who finds himself trapped inside a corporate secret that was never meant to be uncovered.

You are a new employee of the CES corporation, arriving in a quiet industrial town. People greet you warmly, give you simple tasks, introduce you to colleagues. Everything seems ordinary — until you start noticing strange things.

Buses run on perfect schedules. Locals avoid certain streets. And at night, when the city falls asleep, someone remains in the corporation’s laboratories — someone who shouldn’t be there.

Each day brings new fragments — phrases, coincidences, voices hidden in radio static. Are they random, or part of something carefully constructed?

Your job is to observe, collect evidence, and decide who you can trust.
The truth is closer than you think — but the closer you get, the less light remains around you.

🎮 Key Features

  • Atmospheric sci-fi horror with detective elements

  • Non-linear story with multiple endings

  • Inventory and task system

  • Conversations with townspeople and co-workers

  • Hidden threats and a slow, unfolding mystery

data.short_description: Twilight Protocol is an atmospheric detective horror about an employee who becomes trapped in a corporate mystery. Explore the city, gather clues, talk to locals and colleagues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the surface.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-12100 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB or AMD RX 560 4 GB, DirectX 12
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended (HDD load times will be longer). Ray tracing is not used.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 6 GB or AMD RX 5600 XT 6 GB, DirectX 12
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Dynamic resolution scaling may be used; for the best experience, use headphones.

content_descriptors.notes: This is a horror game with a tense atmosphere and jump scares. It contains stylized scenes of violence: cartoonish blood and death without realistic or graphic detail. Occasionally, there are brief allusions to alcohol and cigarettes, but without any condoning context. Themes that are not included include sexual violence/non-consensual sexual acts, sexual acts, and BDSM. There may be loud sounds, flashes, and effects that may frighten sensitive players.
